short_bio: English singer-songwriter whose albums 21 and 25 were among the best-selling of their decade.
biography:
Adele Adkins was born in Tottenham, north London, and attended the BRIT School. Her debut album 19 came out in 2008 and she won the Grammy for Best New Artist the following year.

21 (2011) produced Rolling in the Deep and Someone Like You. 25 (2015) opened with Hello. She co-wrote Skyfall, the theme of the 2012 James Bond film, which took the Oscar for Best Original Song.

30 followed in 2021, and she performed a Las Vegas residency, Weekends with Adele, at Caesars Palace from 2022.
